jp: <STBG 11,0><BGM 0,0,503><TALK 5><NAME 13><CHAR 1,1,1,0,0><CHAR 5,5,11,0,0><CV 16,18>Eliza, Hunter!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,8>Yuno!
What's wrong?

<TALK 5><NAME 13><CV 16,6>Um, it's Solphine...
Solphine is...

<TALK 1><NAME 1>Calm down, Yuno!
What happened to Solphine...?

<CHAR 5,7,12,0,0><CV 1,98>Solphine!
What's wrong!?
You look so haggard...

<CHAR 5,4,12,0,0><CHAR 3,5,12,0,0><CHAR 1,4,1,0,0><TALK 3><NAME 14><CV 17,39>Ugh...
I will never lose to a nightmare!
<CHAR 3,12,12,0,0><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,76><CHAR 1,3,1,0,0>Solphine!

<TALK 5><NAME 13><CHAR 5,1,11,0,0>Lately she's been tossing in her sleep...
but she won't tell us what happened!
Truly, what happened...

Eliza, Hunter!
Please help Solphine!

<TALK 3><NAME 22>Hmm, so that's how it is...
My lord, I may know that symptom.

It is caused by a demon called a succubus
in the place I came from.

That is a demon that clings to men.
No wonder he looks so drained.

What, my lord, you ask what
a succubus does...
<CV 1005,37>Mm, that sort of thing is... troubling...

<ITEM PCOIN00084,0,1>But I recall the cure:
the extract of a Dark Bat.
That is the means of recovery.

Yet in the Dark Bat's habitat,
Pumpkin Uragaan lurk in numbers.

<ITEM AD_BODY129,0,1>To slay them, you'd best gather
Magyul gear, strong against Pumpkin.

<ITEM 0,0,0>Also, the Pumpkin species seems
to drop a strange ticket.

<ITEM AD_HEAD2075,0,1>Guided by that ticket, it is said
you can meet powerful gear
bearing this strange air.

Collecting them while treating him
would be good too.

<ITEM 0,0,0>Before that man says
「after all, I couldn't beat
the nightmare」...

The legend of a bat incarnate
fighting a demon has been told
for ages.

Be careful too, my lord,
lest you be taken by that demon.
<CLS>
